title: Projects, the head
summary: The /projects head: a side composition cast at 104 (“One piece / of the system, / on its own.”, the light accent the middle line), one lede, one quiet jump to the catalogue, then a sheet plate: the SCOPE page of a written scope for positioning and messaging — what it fixes, what we build, what we don't, what you give (coherence pass: the sign-off page with blank dates, price and signatures is retired).

reference.site: GoNimbly (the founder's recordings): the picture directly under the head, the lede behind a vertical rule; ROUND9-PLAN §8 (index head: the written scope as a sheet)
reference.borrowed: GoNimbly's head composition (h1 left, hairline, short lede and one quiet action right) and its full-measure picture under the head.
reference.kelwin: The picture is the offer's own paper: a scope's sign-off page, blank where a price or a date would be — honest by construction. 'Specimen' once, in the running head; mono only for the folio.

motion: on the stitched page: the turn lifts, the h1 writes itself in (kit §13), the hairline, rule, lede and action follow, then the plate rises as a narrower rectangle and widens.
reduced motion: final state at once.
notes: Coherence pass 2: the light accent is the one word “piece” (D3; was the whole middle line); the lede is cut to two lines (“Scoped in writing before it starts, and built to the full install's spec.”). Proposed page (ROUND9-PLAN §8), for the founder's yes. The page owns dates, price and the 30-day review here, once; the body does not restate them. The scope is named for Positioning and messaging so the index does not follow one project through the page. Coherence pass (round 9): see summary. Coherence pass 3: phone floor 50 (44 below 360): at 56 “of the system,” broke to a lone “system,” at 390.
